pi.frontmatter:
name: commit-push
description: "取 commit-message 的一行说明后提交并推送：只暂存本次改动、git commit、push 当前分支。触发：提交并推送 / 提交推送 / commit & push / commit and push / 帮我提交 / 提交一下"

cursor.frontmatter:
name: commit-push
description: >-
  Takes the commit line from commit-message, stages only this change, commits
  it and pushes the current branch. Use when the user asks to commit and push.
  Stops and asks on integration branches, unrelated staged changes, force
  pushes, or hook failures. Does not create branches, merge, or change code.
disable-model-invocation: true
